connector.name: Formio MCP
connector.registryDescription: Create and manage Form.io forms, resources, actions, roles, and projects from your AI agent.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.form, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FORMIO_PROJECT_URL
env.description: Full URL of the Form.io project to target (e.g. https://api.form.io/my-project, or https://your-host/project-name for self-hosted).

env.name: FORMIO_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of your Form.io deployment — the parent of FORMIO_PROJECT_URL (default: https://api.form.io). Set this when self-hosting or using Form.io Enterprise.

env.name: FORMIO_API_KEY
env.description: Form.io project API key. Optional — when omitted the server uses a browser-based portal login flow to obtain a JWT.

env.name: FORMIO_LOGIN_FORM
env.description: URL of a custom login form used by the browser-based portal login flow. Defaults to the deployment's portal login form.

env.name: FORMIO_INSECURE_TLS
env.description: Set to 1 to skip TLS certificate verification. For local development against self-signed certificates only — never enable in production.

recipes.cli: claude mcp add formio --env FORMIO_PROJECT_URL=<formio-project-url> --env FORMIO_BASE_URL=<formio-base-url> --env FORMIO_API_KEY=<your-formio-api-key> --env FORMIO_LOGIN_FORM=<formio-login-form> --env FORMIO_INSECURE_TLS=<formio-insecure-tls> -- npx -y @formio/mcp@0.7.0

recipes.code:
[mcp_servers.formio]
command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "@formio/mcp@0.7.0"]

[mcp_servers.formio.env]
FORMIO_PROJECT_URL = "<formio-project-url>"
FORMIO_BASE_URL = "<formio-base-url>"
FORMIO_API_KEY = "<your-formio-api-key>"
FORMIO_LOGIN_FORM = "<formio-login-form>"
